lots.guide_summary: All AUD, no conversion. Range $7 to $65 hammer from 10 Gowans SOLD results (all category guide: boxes or bundles of unknown contents), no UNSOLD and no ASKING evidence. Typical Gowans comic bundle hammer is $20 to $65; small lots of 1980s Marvel/DC go $16 to $20 unless they hold Spider-Man keys. None is the same item.
lots.working: No same-item SOLD evidence: every entry is a generic Gowans bundle with unknown contents, so under the rules keep and flip maxima are 0. For context only (not a maximum): a mid comparable of $30 hammer would give keep $30/1.22 = $24.59, about $20; a flip from $40 resale less about 15% fees and $15 postage = $19 net, /2.44 = $7.79, about $5. Not worth chasing.
lots.confidence_reason: Titles read from the covers, but no issue numbers visible and no same-item sales; all evidence is category guide (although the Gowans figures were checked in the API). WebSearch cap reached, so Armitage past results could not be searched.
lots.dropped_entries: None dropped. All 8 researcher entries checked against the Gowans API: titles, sale_price, bid counts and listing dates match. Note that the researcher's URLs are API search URLs, not lot pages. Two more category-guide Gowans results added (426239 and 421423).
lots.key_photo_findings: One photo only. Classics Illustrated with yellow banner (Count of Monte Cristo, Silas Marner, The Queen's Necklace, The Man Without a Country) look like later reprints, with some edge wear and toning. Amazing Spider-Man with Marvel corner box, flaming figure on the cover, issue number hidden. Moon Knight (Marvel, red and black cover with crescent-moon cape) could be from the early 1980s Sienkiewicz run, issue unknown. All-Star Squadron, DC newsstand with barcode, Infinity Inc. banner, possibly around #25 or 26 (1983), not confirmed. Everything is in bags, no boards seen, and several books are mostly hidden.
lots.condition: Looks reader grade, roughly VG to F from what shows through the bags. The Classics Illustrated have toned, worn edges; the Marvel/DC newsstand copies look fairly bright. Spines and backs are not visible.
lots.question_for_armitage: How many comics are in the lot, and what are the issue numbers of the Amazing Spider-Man, Moon Knight and All-Star Squadron? Are any Classics Illustrated first printings (original price on the cover rather than a reprint HRN)?
